cause_quote: The new retained-reader guard called `readerOperation.abortSignal.throwIfAborted()` and then threw `SessionWorkStartChangedError("Session reader operation is no longer current")` on release, losing the restart reason when only the owning work signal had aborted.
user_saw: During a gateway restart, an interrupted reply could be recorded as a generic run failure.
summary: The fix passes the owning work signal into database admission so late reader and handoff checks preserve the restart cancellation reason.
reasoning: The earlier restart-release change already allowed the owning work signal to release admission while the reply signal stayed frozen. I checked the introducing diff and its parent: the parent had no retained reply reader or handoff guard, and PR #166703 introduced both with the generic release error. PR #168607 added the session-target lookup exercised by the fix's test and reused the same faulty check.
